svg.title: Illustrative baseline: 24 billion input and 6 billion output tokens per month. Monthly cash bridge: full API bill RMB 45,540.00, less fallback API RMB 910.80, leaves avoided API cost RMB 44,629.20. Less RMB 24,000.00 local operations leaves RMB 20,629.20 to recover initial investment. All amounts come from the shared model. Bar lengths use a common monetary scale; this is not measured performance or realized profit.
